name: Clicking a bracket cell reaches a match detail page that shows kickoff and venue
description: When a visitor clicks a bracket cell and arrives at the match detail page, the destination surfaces both a kickoff time and a venue or host city — proving the click reached a real fixture record, not a stub.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the knockout bracket section
Click any cell in the bracket
Verify the destination URL differs from the homepage URL
Verify the match detail page surfaces a kickoff time (a date, day, or clock time)
Verify the match detail page surfaces a venue, stadium, or host city
